verdict.rationale: Drata's Public API v2 exposes many 'List' endpoints (Personnel, Controls, Risks, Monitoring Tests, Custom Connections) that let an AI agent enumerate and iterate over many items programmatically, and docs mention AI agents interacting via natural language to automate workflows, implying some capacity for scripted bulk actions. However, there is no documented dedicated bulk-operation endpoint (e.g., batch update/create/delete across many controls or policies at once) — only single-item create/update endpoints are listed. Missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk API endpoints, evidence of true multi-item atomic operations, and independent confirmation of bulk-scale automation in practice.
